records.text: President Donald Trump appointed Erika Kirk to the United States Air Force Academy Board of Visitors.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: President Trump (Donald J. Trump) has appointed Erika Kirk to the Air Force Academy's Board of Visitors.

verification.notes: Transcript context states Trump appointed Erika Kirk to the USAFA Board of Visitors. The current official USAFA board page lists Erika Kirk among the presidential appointees, and contemporaneous reporting identifies President Donald Trump as the appointing president.

sources.title: Board of Visitors — United States Air Force Academy
sources.relevance: Official board roster lists Erika Kirk among members appointed by the President.

sources.title: Erika Kirk added to Air Force Academy oversight board
sources.relevance: Reports that President Donald Trump appointed Erika Kirk.

records.text: The Air Force Academy Board of Visitors has 15 other members who recommend changes to the Defense Secretary and report annually on the academy's morale, finances, and academics.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: With this appointment, Erika (Erika Kirk) joins just 15 other members. That's how exclusive this board is. There's just 15 other members and they are responsible, just so you understand what the job requires. They're responsible for making recommendations to the Defense Secretary, Pete Hegseth. regarding changes to the Air Force Academy. They're also tasked with providing an annual report regarding the military institute's morale, its finances, its financial state, and its academics.

verification.notes: The official 2024-2026 charter confirms the board advises the Defense Secretary through the Air Force Secretary and reviews morale, curriculum, fiscal affairs, and academics. However, it specified 15 total members, not 15 other members, and required semiannual rather than annual reports. The statement is materially right about duties but wrong on membership count and reporting frequency.

sources.title: Charter — Board of Visitors of the U.S. Air Force Academy
sources.relevance: Official charter establishes duties, 15-member composition, semiannual reports, and reporting path to the Defense Secretary.

records.text: Charlie Kirk earned an appointment to the Air Force Academy board in March 2025, six months before he was assassinated.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Charlie (Charlie Kirk), by the way, had himself earned that appointment and there was backlash going, wait, whoa, this is a very big deal. We shouldn't be mixing politics with this. He had earned that appointment in March of 2025. So just six months before he was assassinated.

verification.notes: Official and specialist records confirm President Trump appointed Charlie Kirk to the USAFA Board of Visitors on March 17, 2025. Kirk was assassinated on September 10, 2025, about six months later.
